checks.finding: The page has a viewport tag that tells phones to fit it to the screen, which is what Lighthouse's viewport audit checks for.
checks.label: Mobile viewport tag

checks.finding: The viewport tag does not block pinch-to-zoom, so visitors can enlarge text if they need to.
checks.label: Pinch-to-zoom allowed

checks.finding: The page's own CSS sets some text below 12px (10px, 11px); Lighthouse flags pages where less than 60% of text is 12px or larger, so this is worth a look.
checks.label: Text size (code hint)

checks.finding: In Google's simulated mobile test, the Lighthouse performance score is 96/100 (good; 90+ is good) and Largest Contentful Paint is 1.8 s (good); Google calls 2.5 s or less good. Also measured: layout shift (CLS) 0.02 (good), Total Blocking Time 120 ms (good).
checks.label: Mobile speed (Google PageSpeed)

checks.finding: The page has a title, "Grace Church", which Google often uses as the headline in results.
checks.label: Page title

checks.finding: The page has a meta description, which Google may use as the snippet under the title.
checks.label: Meta description

checks.finding: The page has a main heading: "Grace Church".
checks.label: Main heading (H1)

checks.finding: The site loads over https.
checks.label: Secure (https)

checks.finding: The page has no canonical link; that is optional, but without it Google picks the preferred version itself.
checks.label: Canonical link

checks.finding: The site has a robots.txt file and it does not block the whole site.
checks.label: robots.txt

checks.finding: We found an XML sitemap listing the site's pages for search engines.
checks.label: Sitemap

checks.finding: The homepage (footer included) shows a worship day and time; Lifeway reports hard-to-find times are a top reason guests don't come.
checks.label: Service times

checks.finding: The homepage (footer included) shows a street address; Lifeway's 2023 survey found location among the most helpful website items (66%).
checks.label: Street address

checks.finding: The menu has a first-time guest link ("I'm New"), which Lifeway recommends prioritizing.
checks.label: Visit path in the menu

checks.finding: A guest can find a visit, directions, or location link, or your address, on the homepage.
checks.label: Plan a visit / location

checks.finding: We couldn't find a Google or Apple Maps link or an embedded map; Grey Matter Research found 28% of visitors look for a map or directions.
checks.label: Map or directions link

checks.finding: The homepage has a tap-to-call (tel:) phone link.
checks.label: Tap-to-call phone link

checks.finding: The homepage shows a phone number, an email address and a street address; Lifeway's 2023 survey found 39% of website-first visitors valued contact info.
checks.label: Contact info

checks.finding: The homepage has a give or giving-service link, so giving is one click away.
checks.label: Give one click away

checks.finding: There is a Beliefs or About link; in Lifeway's 2023 survey, beliefs and mission were the most helpful website item (67%).
checks.label: Beliefs or About link

checks.finding: We couldn't check this because we couldn't read a city from your address.
checks.label: City in title or main heading

checks.finding: We counted about 6 links in the header menu, which reads as streamlined.
checks.label: Menu size

checks.finding: Some menu labels may be unfamiliar to a guest ("Narthex"); NN/g advises clear, familiar labels over branded or vague words.
checks.label: Menu labels
